notes.title: Minor patch 1.51 is now live!
notes.content: This simple patch introduces a simple but important change: it allows you to recover health based on your rank after completing a dungeon. Therefore, the higher your rank, the more health you'll recover at the end of each dungeon.

tags.feature: it allows you to recover health based on your rank after completing a dungeon. Therefore, the higher your rank, the more health you'll recover at the end of each dungeon.

notes.title: v1.4 update patch is now live!
notes.content:
This patch will bring only one change... one big change:
- At powerup rooms you will recover 75% of your maximum health (50% if in hard mode)

This change is essential to get help progressing through dungeons: this update helps a lot expecially on the final levels of the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is now available! (and with it the "Nutaku" version)
notes.content:
The update patch 1.3 is live. Here some changes of this release:

TIP: Visit www.ashandtor.com/help-and-suggestions/
Here you will find very useful gameplay tips

VERSION 1.3 (that includes the "Nutaku" release)
- Ero+ version released on Nutaku.net
- In Ero+ version fury charges faster and critical hits restores more health
- Added a cheat code, discoverable only by Nutaku users (starts with 69xxxxxx)
- If you save all the girls in a dungeon, you will get a higher score in every game
- 'Nutaku' bears added: can be found randomly into dungeons
- The 'Nutaku' bears will unlock other images into gallery
- Added fury orbs: just crack some wall to obtain it (except for Deep Dungeon)
- Bugfix: wrong reward icon if already saved 6/12/18/24 stage's girl

... and other minor changes
... ... DLC containing all cards (except the sexually explicit ones) is almost ready

The Nutaku version is available here: https://www.nutaku.net/games/ash-and-tor/

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 has been released
notes.content:
The version 1.0.1 of Ash and Tor has been released. Here the changes:

MAJOR CHANGES
- "Soul Points" system added to the game (to help who dies often)

MINOR CHANGES
- All bosses are "a bit easier" in hard mode
- Earn extra score points when reach the exit
- In hard mode you'll find gold bags instead of extra hp (in powerup rooms)
- Killing all enemies gives you more score points (in hard mode)
- Darker screen while entering the dungeons
- If at full hp, you pass over hp vials (but not goblin vials)
- Some minor changes

BUG FIXES
- Scoring "S" badge issue on hard mode
- Wrong screen color applied to frozen dungeon
- Showing "Thanks for playing" message if you die at lvl.24 boss

notes.title: Early Access has ended! Version 1.0 stable released
notes.content:
The "Early Access" has ended! Version 1.0 stable released, here the changelog:

VERSION 1.0 - STABLE

MAJOR CHANGES

- Early Access has ended!
- Deep Dungeon is completed

MINOR CHANGES

- Ending the game will unlocks a new game start type
- Added 'Golden Coins' to the game
- Added 'chickens' (grants level up) for easy mode
- Bosses hp bar repositioned in bottom position
- Better recover from exhaust
- Better shadows
- Optimized animations
- Some minor changes
- Auto deactivate hints if you finish the game
- Stage 18: Monsters do more damage
- Translation error for Ash special
- Dialogue variations for Ash and Tor
- Cannot take S score if you don't kill all monsters
- Special rewards prerequisites are changed
- Stage 18 girl prerequisites are changed
- At stage 18 boss is much easier to take a good score
- Better screen dimming if holding ancient tarots

BUG FIXES

- Bug fix: Wrong damage applied for spikes
- Bug fix: Duplicated item icon (Pendant of conversion/Ice Cloth)
- Bug fix: Incorrect skin for switches
- Bug fix: Frozen boss lowering too much the rank score
- Bug fix: Library unreachable
- Bug fix: Wrong reward slaying Jungle Boss
- Bug fix: Invisible girl calls for help
- Bug fix: Tor's special icon won't disappear correctly
- Bug fix: Bag of coins icon was incorrect sometimes
- Bug fix: Fullscreen issue
- Bug fix: Switches issues about gates opening
- Bug fix: Solved some bugs related to pressure plates
- Bug fix: Fireballs issues on game pause
- Bug fix: Hit miss on barrels
- Bug fix: Missing Tor's Omnikey icon
- Bug fix: Skeleton's layer

notes.title: Anti-freeze patch - 26/11/2023
notes.content:
A relevant bug freezes the game after killing the first boss, so this update is mandatory! A secondary important bug was found: sometimes the characters can leave the stage even if misaligned.

Here all the changes of this important update:

CHANGELOG - VERSION 1.0.1

MAJOR CHANGES AND BUG FIXES

- Solved a bug that blocks user input after bosses
- Solved a bug where can end a stage even if misaligned
- Solved bug that cause incorrect brightness set

MINOR CHANGES

- The game will forced to pause if the controller is removed
- Font changed for Ash and Tor dialogues
- When taking damage, the screen shakes and flashes red
- Better death animations for slimes
- No girls imprisoned if you've unlocked them
- Shows a preview of the girl to be saved
- Add +1 HP to Ash each time he uses "safe dome"
- Ash got +1 STR and -1 VIT attributes at start

- Solved a bug where can end a stage even if misaligned
- Solved bug that cause incorrect brightness set
